title: Valiant Spring 2016 Preview Comic 4001 A.D. Divinity II Archer & Armstrong Promo
conditionDescription: Clean and bright with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Valiant Spring 2016 - free promotional preview comic featuring 4001 A.D. #1, Divinity II #1 and A&A: The Adventures of Archer & Armstrong #1.

Back cover: Faith Vol. 1: Hollywood & Vine ad.

Condition: clean and bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
